AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_MPC_TMPL A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON A.MONITORTMPLID = B.ID WHERE A.MONITORPOINTCATEGORYID = T.ID AND B.ACTIVATEDFLAG = '1')
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
